name: lvm-weightlifting
description: Plataforma SaaS para gestao de atletas de levantamento de peso olimpico.

scripts.dev:local: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev -w @lvm/api" "npm run dev -w @lvm/web"
scripts.build:api: npm run prisma:generate -w @lvm/api && npm run build -w @lvm/api
scripts.start:api:prod: npm run prisma:migrate -w @lvm/api && npm run prisma:seed -w @lvm/api && npm run seed:test-accounts -w @lvm/api && npm run start -w @lvm/api
